newsitem.title: UK: UK shares set record after Dow's sharp advance.
newsitem.headline: UK shares set record after Dow's sharp advance.

text.p: UK shares opened higher on Tuesday, led by another impressive performance on Wall Street and supported by renewed optimism over the near-term domestic interest rate outlook.

The FTSE 100 index was up 22 points at 4,459.4 by 0855 GMT, passing the previous all-time high of 4,440.8 set on Monday. Advancing stocks outnumbered losers by four-to-one. Second-line stocks also climbed into record breaking territory.
The Mid-250 index added 2.6 points to 4,731.8. The previous closing high was 4,729.2.
